title: dnd-5e-2024 item stats (docs/rulesets.md#items)
description: Stored inputs only; magic items derive nothing in v1 except an embedded stat block's ability modifiers and saves (docs/rulesets.md#the-ruleset-module). saveDc and attackBonus are authored. Cross-field rules are checks in checks.ts (docs/rulesets.md#consistency-checks).

baseItem.description: The equipment the item is built on, required for armor and weapons, as links the template words (docs/rulesets.md#items): `oneOf` lists items ("Longsword or Rapier"); `any` lists groups or items with variants ("Any Simple or Martial"), with `except` naming members it leaves out (", Except Hide Armor").

rarity.description: The rarity, read in title case. "varies" reads "Rarity Varies" unless rarityVariants gives each variant's.

rarityVariants.description: The rarity of each variant of an item whose rarity is "varies", printed in place of "Rarity Varies": "Uncommon (+1), Rare (+2), or Very Rare (+3)" (docs/rulesets.md#items).

requirement.description: Who may attune, such as "by a spellcaster". Only when attunement is required.

charges.description: Charges, read "7; regains 1d6 + 1 daily at dawn".

max.description: A whole number, or a rolled count as printed: "1d3", "1d8 + 1".

recharge.description: How charges come back. Omitted for an item that never regains them.

depletion.description: What happens when the last charge is spent.

spells.description: Spells the item casts, with authored costs, DCs, and attack bonuses.

chargeCost.description: Charges per casting, or the least for a variable cost.

maxChargeCost.description: The most a casting can spend, for a variable cost: reads "1–3 charges".

saveDc.description: The item's stated save DC, authored.

attackBonus.description: The item's stated spell attack bonus, authored. 0 is a real value.

statBlocks.description: Stat blocks printed only inside this item, such as a figurine's creature.
